The '''Randa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Randa/Legends|Randa]].
